title: Russian Ship Sinks in Libya After Suspected Drone Attack
subtitle: The incident in Benghazi highlights the expanding reach of the ongoing conflict between Russia and Ukraine.

summary.en: A Russian warship, the Merkury, sank in the Libyan port of Benghazi following a suspected drone attack on Sunday. Libyan officials reported that the ship was refueling when it was struck, causing a large explosion. While no group has claimed responsibility, experts suggest the operation was likely carried out by Ukrainian forces. A second commercial vessel was also targeted off the coast shortly after the first attack. The eastern Libyan government has condemned the incident as a violation of its national sovereignty.
summary.zh: 一艘俄羅斯軍艦「水星號」於週日在利比亞班加西港口疑似遭到無人機攻擊後沉沒。利比亞官員報告稱，該艦在加油時遭到攻擊，引發劇烈爆炸。雖然目前沒有組織承認犯案，但專家認為該行動極可能由烏克蘭軍方執行。在首起攻擊發生後不久，另一艘商用船隻也在該海域遭到鎖定。利比亞東部政府已譴責此事件，稱其侵犯了國家主權。

paragraphs.en: A Russian warship docked at a naval base in Benghazi, Libya, was destroyed in a suspected drone attack on Sunday morning. According to the BBC, the ship, identified as the Merkury, was stopped at the port to refuel and collect supplies while traveling back to Russia. Satellite images and videos shared on social media show the vessel on fire before it eventually capsized and sank.
paragraphs.zh: 一艘停靠在利比亞班加西（Benghazi）海軍基地的俄羅斯軍艦，於週日上午疑似遭到無人機攻擊而毀損。根據英國廣播公司（BBC）報導，這艘名為「水星號」（Merkury）的艦艇當時正停泊在該港口進行補給與加油，準備返回俄羅斯。社群媒體上流傳的衛星影像與影片顯示，該艦艇在起火後最終翻覆並沉沒。

paragraphs.en: Libyan officials from the country’s eastern government confirmed the explosion occurred at dawn. While the ship was lost, authorities reported that there were no deaths. Later in the day, a second vessel—a commercial cargo ship—was also targeted by a drone off the coast of Benghazi. The Libyan health ministry stated that some crew members from the second ship were injured, though their conditions were reported as stable.
paragraphs.zh: 利比亞東部政府官員證實，爆炸發生於黎明時分。儘管軍艦沉沒，當局表示並無人員傷亡。當天稍晚，另一艘商用貨船也在班加西外海遭到無人機鎖定。利比亞衛生部指出，第二艘船上有部分船員受傷，但目前狀況穩定。

paragraphs.en: Libya has been divided between two rival governments since the 2011 uprising that removed long-time leader Muammar Gaddafi. The eastern-based government, which controls the area where the attack took place, has condemned the incident. In an official statement, they called the strike a violation of maritime safety and an attack on Libya’s sovereignty. The administration emphasized that Libya is not a party to the war between Russia and Ukraine and stated it would not allow its ports or waters to be used as a place for international conflicts.
paragraphs.zh: 自二〇一一年推翻長期執政的領導人格達費（Muammar Gaddafi）後，利比亞一直處於兩個敵對政府分治的狀態。控制此次攻擊發生區域的東部政府對此事件表示譴責。他們在官方聲明中稱，這次攻擊違反了海上安全，並侵犯了利比亞的主權。該行政當局強調，利比亞並非俄烏戰爭的參與方，並表示不會允許其港口或水域成為國際衝突的場所。

paragraphs.en: While no group has officially claimed responsibility for the explosions, experts believe the attack is linked to the ongoing war in Ukraine. Jalel Harchaoui, a Libya specialist at the Royal United Services Institute (RUSI), told the BBC that Ukraine is the most likely actor capable of such an operation. The Guardian reported that Ukraine has developed a strong sea drone capability during the conflict, which has previously forced the Russian fleet to retreat from parts of the Black Sea. If confirmed, this strike would represent a significant expansion of the war, moving the fighting thousands of kilometers away from the main frontlines in eastern Europe.
paragraphs.zh: 雖然目前沒有任何組織正式承認犯案，但專家認為此次攻擊與烏克蘭境內持續進行的戰爭有關。英國皇家聯合軍事研究所（RUSI）的利比亞問題專家哈查威（Jalel Harchaoui）向BBC表示，烏克蘭是最有能力執行此類行動的潛在對象。《衛報》報導指出，烏克蘭在衝突期間發展出強大的海上無人機戰力，此前已迫使俄羅斯艦隊從黑海部分區域撤退。若此消息屬實，這場攻擊將代表戰爭規模顯著擴大，將戰火從東歐的主要前線延伸至數千公里之外。

paragraphs.en: This is not the first time such an incident has occurred in the Mediterranean. In March, Russia accused Ukraine of using sea drones to target a tanker in the area between Libya and Malta. Analysts note that these types of attacks are designed to hurt Russia’s ability to export oil and gas using its so-called "shadow fleet"—a group of older, often poorly tracked tankers used to move fuel despite international sanctions, which are official rules that limit trade to punish a country.
paragraphs.zh: 這並非地中海首次發生此類事件。今年三月，俄羅斯曾指控烏克蘭利用海上無人機，鎖定利比亞與馬爾他之間海域的一艘油輪。分析人士指出，這類攻擊旨在削弱俄羅斯利用所謂「影子艦隊」出口石油與天然氣的能力；這些影子艦隊由一群老舊且難以追蹤的油輪組成，用於在國際制裁（即限制貿易以懲罰特定國家的官方規定）下運送燃料。

paragraphs.en: Following the Sunday attack, the eastern Libyan government announced it is working with Russian officials to investigate the source of the drones. Libyan naval forces reported that they intercepted several other drone boats off the coast during the evening, suggesting the attack involved multiple units. The administration stated that port operations would resume once the site was secured and the fire was under control.
paragraphs.zh: 週日的攻擊事件後，利比亞東部政府宣布正與俄羅斯官員合作，調查無人機的來源。利比亞海軍部隊表示，當晚在海岸附近攔截了其他幾艘無人艇，顯示該次攻擊涉及多個單位。當局表示，待現場安全且火勢受到控制後，港口作業將會恢復。

paragraphs.en: Meanwhile, the government in Tripoli, which is internationally recognized, warned against the dangers of hosting foreign military forces. They expressed "serious fears" regarding the risks of allowing foreign ships to use civilian facilities, noting that such actions threaten the safety of local citizens and national assets.
paragraphs.zh: 與此同時，獲得國際承認的利比亞首都的黎波里（Tripoli）政府，針對接待外國軍事力量的危險性提出警告。他們對允許外國船艦使用民用設施所帶來的風險表示「嚴重擔憂」，並指出此類行為威脅了當地公民的安全與國家資產。

paragraphs.en: As the investigation continues, the event highlights how the conflict between Russia and Ukraine is increasingly spreading to other parts of the world. With the Merkury now at the bottom of the port, the incident serves as a reminder of the growing reach of modern drone technology in naval warfare. For now, both the Libyan authorities and international observers are waiting to see how Moscow will respond to the loss of its warship.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著調查持續進行，此事件凸顯了俄烏衝突正日益擴散至世界其他地區。隨著水星號沉入港口底部，這起事件也提醒世人，現代無人機技術在海戰中的影響力正不斷增長。目前，利比亞當局與國際觀察家都在等待莫斯科將如何回應其軍艦損失的事件。

quiz.question: What was the primary purpose of the Russian warship 'Merkury' stopping at the port of Benghazi?

options.A: To participate in a joint military exercise with Libyan forces.
options.B: To refuel and obtain necessary supplies while returning to Russia.
options.C: To provide security for the commercial cargo ship that was later attacked.
options.D: To deliver humanitarian aid to the eastern government of Libya.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確指出該艦艇（Merkury）停靠在班加西港口是為了「refuel and collect supplies」（加油並收集物資），當時正準備返回俄羅斯。選項 A 錯誤，因為文中未提及軍事演習；選項 C 錯誤，因為該貨船是在隨後才被攻擊，並非護航對象；選項 D 錯誤，文章中並未提及人道救援相關內容。

quiz.question: Based on the information provided, why might the Tripoli-based government be critical of the eastern government's actions?

options.A: They believe the eastern government is secretly funding the Ukrainian drone program.
options.B: They want to take direct control of the port to increase their own oil exports.
options.C: They are concerned that allowing foreign military vessels to dock puts Libyan civilians and infrastructure at risk.
options.D: They are angry that the eastern government did not share the intelligence regarding the drone attack.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。根據倒數第二段，受到國際認可的黎波里政府明確表示，對於允許外國軍艦使用民用設施感到「嚴重擔憂」（serious fears），並指出這威脅到了當地公民的安全與國家資產。選項 A 無根據；選項 B 雖提及油氣，但與此處對軍艦停靠的批評無關；選項 D 錯誤，文中並未提及情報分享問題。

quiz.question: In the fifth paragraph, what does the term 'shadow fleet' refer to?

options.A: A group of older, poorly tracked tankers used by Russia to bypass international trade sanctions.
options.B: A secret unit of unmanned drones designed to operate undetected in the Mediterranean.
options.C: Military vessels that travel without lights or identification to avoid being spotted by satellites.
options.D: A collection of abandoned ships that have been repurposed for naval warfare by rebel groups.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 A。文中第五段明確定義「shadow fleet」為「a group of older, often poorly tracked tankers used to move fuel despite international sanctions」，意指俄羅斯用來規避制裁的舊油輪群。選項 B 混淆了無人機與油輪的概念；選項 C 雖符合「shadow」的字面暗示，但並非文中定義；選項 D 錯誤，這些船隻並非被遺棄的船隻，而是被俄羅斯主動利用的工具。

quiz.question: What is the central message of the article?

options.A: The civil war in Libya has finally come to an end due to international intervention.
options.B: The Russian navy is significantly stronger than the Ukrainian drone forces in the Mediterranean.
options.C: The war between Russia and Ukraine is expanding geographically, impacting global maritime security and local stability.
options.D: Drone technology is now the only effective weapon used in modern naval warfare.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。全文的核心在於探討俄烏戰爭如何擴散至地中海地區，並透過班加西的攻擊事件，強調這場衝突已跨越歐洲前線，影響到利比亞的安全與國際航運。選項 A 與事實相反；選項 B 錯誤，文中提到俄軍艦艇被擊沉，顯示其處於劣勢；選項 D 過於誇大，文中僅提到無人機技術的成長，並未說它是「唯一」有效的武器。
